receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI to reduce its dependency on Microsoft whose Azure cloud service had served as the ChatGPT maker's exclusive data center infrastructure provider until January.

evidence_items.explanation: Azure was OpenAI's exclusive provider until January 2025, which helps explain the claim. The same report says OpenAI relies on Oracle and CoreWeave and finalized a Google deal in May 2025.
